aggregation_stories.title: Boeing Delivers 51 Jets In August
aggregation_stories.summary: Boeing announced it delivered 51 jets in August, a decrease from the previous month and year, mainly due to fewer 787 Dreamliner handovers. The company shipped 41 737 MAX jets and only four 787 Dreamliners, with deliveries to customers like Southwest Airlines and United Airlines. Boeing aims to meet its annual Dreamliner delivery target and has booked 453 orders year-to-date after cancellations.

general_news.title: Delta flight to Phoenix returns to JFK amid 'possible pressurization issue'

Both the FAA and Delta confirmed the incident, stating standard procedures were followed.
